name: Yinchuan Hedong International Airport
before:
Ningxia's main aviation gateway, 25 km south east of Yinchuan in the town of Linghe. It handled 9,860,514 passengers in 2025, forty second in China, and reaches 57 cities either directly or by connecting at Xi'an or Beijing.

Getting into the city is cheap and clear. Shuttle buses run from the Yinchuan Civil Aviation Building and the Yuehai Urban Terminal for 20 yuan, and there are three daily round trips from the Wuzhong Hotel. A taxi to the city centre usually costs about 80 yuan, on a base fare of 7 yuan for the first 3 km. There is also a station on the Yinchuan to Lanzhou high speed railway, opened in 2019.

Check which terminal a flight uses. Terminal 1 handles international flights along with Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan services. Terminal 2 is closed for renovation. There are also four satellite city terminals away from the airport itself.

The runway is 3,600 metres, and the airport doubles as an important alternate for Lanzhou and Xi'an.

The name Hedong means east of the river, after its position east of the Yellow River.
after:
Ningxia's main airport, 25 km south east of Yinchuan at Linhe, in Lingwu City. It handled about 9.86 million passengers in 2025, making it the 42nd busiest airport in China.

Airport buses to the Yuehai city terminal cost 20 yuan. There is also a station on the Yinchuan to Lanzhou high speed railway, opened in 2019.

Domestic flights use Terminal 3, opened in December 2016. International flights, along with those to Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan, moved into a new hall in Terminal 2 in February 2018.

The runway is 3,600 metres.

claims.note: Wording plainer than 'main aviation gateway'. Ningxia's three airports passed 10 million passengers together in 2025, of which Yinchuan handled 9.86 million; Zhongwei expected about 320,000.

sources.quote: it nevertheless is the autonomous region's main aviation gateway

claims.note: Coordinates put the airport 19.3 km in a straight line at 147 degrees (south east) from the GeoNames centre, so 25 km is inside the 0.8 to 1.6 tolerance for a road distance. Two guides (Travel China Guide and a Tencent profile) give 19 km, which is the straight-line figure. Left at 25 km as the method allows; the owner may prefer 'about 20 km'.

claims.note: Replaces 'Terminal 1 handles international flights' and 'Terminal 2 is closed for renovation'. T2 closed for rebuilding when T3 opened in December 2016 and reopened with the new international hall on 8 February 2018, when the old hall in T1 closed. The article's own facilities section, and Travel China Guide which repeats it, still describe the 2016 to 2018 interval. No source from the last 12 months names the international terminal, so this is written as a dated event; China Eastern's airport guide still gives this layout. Worth a check with the operator before it is served.

sources.quote: On February 8, 2018, the new international hall (T2 terminal) of Yinchuan Hedong International Airport was officially opened, and the original international hall (T1 terminal) was closed.
